name: products-create
description: A product creation skill based on the Tradebee Website Builder Open API. It is used to create a new product under a specified site language and product group, with support for images, attributes, tags, product descriptions, and SEO data.

language.description: Required. Exact site language code to publish into, such as `en` or `fr`. Do not guess or translate it. First call `languages-get`, show the language list to the user, then copy one exact `language` value the user confirms.

products.description: Required. Complete product payload for a new product. Treat this as the product that will actually be published.

productsgroup_id.description: Required. Leaf product group ID for the new product. First call `productsgroup-read`, then copy one exact `productsgroup_id` where `is_leaf === true`. Do not use parent group IDs and do not use `0`.

product_name.description: Required. Product title shown to users, up to 300 characters.

model.description: Optional. Product model, up to 50 characters.

upload_images.description: Required. Provide 1 to 5 images. The first image becomes the main image shown for the product.

name.description: Image file label used to identify this image inside the payload.

base64.description: Base64 image data with MIME prefix, for example `image/jpeg;base64,...`. Each image must be 500 kB or smaller.

attributes.description: Optional. Visible product attribute list, up to 15 items, for values like material, size, or color.

tags.description: Required in practice. Provide 1 to 6 unique search keyword tags. Each tag must contain 3 to 50 characters.

brief_description.description: Required. Short plain-text summary, up to 127 characters.

description.description:

seo.description: Optional. SEO metadata for search engines.

title.description: Optional. Optimized title, up to 90 characters.

description.description: Optional. Optimized description, up to 200 characters.

keywords.description: Optional. SEO keywords as one comma-separated string, with up to 6 keywords and total length 120 characters or fewer.

confirmation.description: Required. Proof that the user explicitly approved this exact product creation request after seeing the final language and payload.

approved.description: Must be `true` only after the user explicitly confirms the language and exact product payload to be created. Never set this to `true` based on assumption.

summary.description: Required confirmation note that restates the language and exact product payload shown to the user before execution.

status.description: Request status. `true` indicates success and `false` indicates failure.

url.description: Preview URL for the created product. Always return this to the user and ask the user to preview it.

products.productsgroup_id.description: Select a leaf group ID from `productsgroup-read` where `is_leaf === true`. Parent groups and `0` are not allowed.
